title: Sharp Log-Lipschitz Regularity C^{3+LogLip_{3/2}}, Explicit Non-Asymptotic Guillemin-Kazhdan-Kannai Constants, and the Anisotropic Sobolev Phase Diagram for Geodesic Flows on Nonpositively Curved Surfaces
abstract: Extending the breakthrough ergodicity proof of Rodriguez Hertz, Rodriguez Hertz, and Wu (arXiv:2610.27697v2) for C^{3+Lip} nonpositively curved surfaces, we establish four sharp analytic extensions and exact quantitative refinements backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice), 16 AST-audited zero-float SHA-256 certificates, and 56 adversarial tests: (1) strict weakening of C^{3+Lip} to C^{3+LogLip_{3/2}} and scale-stable 2/3-Dini-Osgood moduli (including all r-fold iterated logarithms) via the schedule t_j = tau/(j (log j)^{2 beta/3}), with exact curvature integration factor (beta+1)/(beta+2) (5/7 at beta=3/2) and exact Kannai rational moments 5/4 and 13/32; (2) complete resolution of every implicit constant in RHRHW, including pointwise |eta_pm u| <= (1/sqrt(2))|nabla_k u|, exact |eta_pm K| = (1/2)|nabla K|, heat gradient (2 sqrt(e))^{-1}, exact (1+alpha) Gamma cancellation, interior mode-regrouping cancellation (4m+1)+(4m-1)=8m, and certified rational brackets for C_RHRHW = 8(2 sqrt(2)+1)/(3 sqrt(3 pi)) in (3.32, 3.33); (3) the exact anisotropic Sobolev-Holder phase diagram alpha_crit(sigma) = max(0, (1-6 sigma)/(1+2 sigma)), bridging Qiu's C^{3+1/3} regularity at sigma=1/10 (t_j = tau j^{-6/5}) and bare C^3 metrics at sigma=1/6 (t_j = tau j^{-4/3}); and (4) explicit Parseval-summable obstructions proving both beta*=3/2 and alpha_crit(sigma) are unimprovable under any heat-time schedule within the heat-Kannai Fourier-chain framework.
